blocks.html:
Ford Transit Van Decals

The decals for both of these Aeropark Ford Transits transporters were quick to apply by our experienced installer. The time-lapse video shows the process we follow when vinyl is applied. Our installers have many years of experience applying vinyl van decals to vehicles.

We recommend speaking to our installation crew if you like to learn more, call 416-746-1381 or email info@vinylwraptoronto.com. Usually, we wrap the cargo versions of these Ford Transits. Our graphics team had less space to work with for the logo on this vehicle this time. The customer did not want the design covering the windows or applying perforated vinyl onto the windows. Originally the customer did not ask us to apply a logo to the back. The customer changed his mind after he saw the mock-up our in-house created for the vans.

We were able to put the van decals on the Aeropark Transits and return the vehicles to the customer within 24 hours. The quick turnaround limited the amount of downtime for each of the vans. We generally like to keep any vehicle for a minimum of 24 hours during the winter period. This is so we can warm up the van, making the vinyl application easier. We also need time and heat for the vinyl glue or adhesive to stick to the bodywork. The installation crew prefers to have the vehicle in the shop for 48 hours.
